energy_direction_results_by_model_and_fo.direction_rule: condition_b_minus_a must match fresh train anchors per model and fold

disaggregated_metrics_intervals_and_samp.minimum_cell_count_rule: reported cells must be explicit; no pooled imputation

status.principle: The audit must end in one terminal state.

audited_paths_hashes_and_terminal_classe.principle: Inputs are trusted only by path bytes and terminal class.

independent_row_checkpoint_and_decision_.principle: Rows, checkpoints, and decisions are replayed without candidate self-attestation.

MODEL_SPECS.principle: The three mandated local model identities must stay explicit.

models_audited.principle: Every audited model is listed so no model can hide in an average.

corpus_and_split_replay_receipts.principle: Exact fixture corpus, sidecars, controls, and splits must replay from hashes.

checkpoint_reload_and_score_identity_by_.principle: Checkpoint metadata is reloaded instead of trusting a prior score table.

claim_flip_pair_swap_label_permutation_a.principle: Semantic and evaluator controls catch direction, label, and consumer shortcuts.

aa_noise_norm_length_final_pool_and_prom.principle: Noise, scalar, pool, and receipt controls block cheap rescue paths.

truncation_duplicate_missing_checkpoint_.principle: Structural mutations catch row loss, checkpoint swaps, and model ID leakage.

split_and_held_label_leakage_results.principle: Group splits and held labels must stay hidden from probe selection.

random_label_and_random_pair_controls.principle: Randomized controls prove the audit is not fitting noise after failure.

energy_direction_results_by_model_and_fo.principle: Direction must pass per model and fold before readiness can pass.

disaggregated_metrics_intervals_and_samp.principle: Counts and intervals expose underpowered cells.

failed_harm_underpowered_missing_and_fla.principle: Every failed, missing, flagged, or underpowered cell remains visible.

pooled_rescue_attempt_count.principle: A bare zero proves no aggregate rescue was attempted.

source_model_weight_mutation_count.principle: A bare zero proves no source model weights were changed.

audit_mutation_manifest_path_and_hash.principle: Mutation rules are frozen by bytes before metric replay.

model_local_probe_integrity_ready_score.principle: Readiness is one only when all adequate cells and controls pass.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: Protected project files must remain byte-identical.

preconditions_checked.principle: Inputs, seeds, mutations, and protected hashes are checked first.

inference_substrate.principle: The substrate declares deterministic replay with no new model inference.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: True records this integrity verifier as the gate authority.

field_provenance.principle: Every field names the sources used to build it.

field_principles.principle: Each required field states the failure mode it guards.

test_commands.principle: Commands bind the artifact to tests, coverage, run, and adversarial checks.

test_exit_codes.principle: Exit codes keep failed checks from becoming readiness.

duration_s.principle: Measured wall time is recorded without padding.

random_seeds.principle: Seeds make mutation and control order reproducible.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A stable checksum detects artifact drift.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict uses a terminal prefix and reports the audit outcome.
